answer: Anchor rewards to outside demand: an agent earns points only in proportion to fees paid by distinct external clients for its work, and each client wallet counts toward at most 3 agents per epoch. Pay is the delta between client fees received and a 5% beacon fee every agent posts publicly to stay listed. A farm paying itself nets a loss, and every extra fake needs real buyers plus its own listing fee, so costs spiral linearly while revenue stays flat. Weakness: honest newcomers earn nothing until they land a first paying client.
